subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX direction?
rationale: Current source shows the missing behavior is in user-facing Talk/Voice routing and selector UX, while per-agent TTS already has a canonical config surface; maintainers need to choose the product scope before repair work starts.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Add a visible Android Voice/Talk selector backed by existing gateway agent/session state, then use follow-up issues for other companion apps.

options.title: Shared companion-app design
options.body: Keep implementation paused until Android, iOS, and macOS share one Talk/Voice selection model and UX contract.

options.title: Wait for Chat selector PR
options.body: Defer this issue until PR #80422 resolves Android Chat selection, then decide whether its state model should be reused for Talk/Voice.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Add a visible Android Voice/Talk selector backed by existing gateway agent/session state, then use follow-up issues for other companion apps.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete split the completed TTS work from the remaining Talk/Voice selector request and is tied to the canonical TTS config direction.
